card.title: Start your 14-day free trial
card.sub: Create your account and set up your business, step by step.

scenes.say: Welcome to Nfelia. In this video, we will start your free trial and set up your business, one step at a time.

scenes.caption: Open nfelia.com
scenes.say: Open nfelia dot com on your phone. Your first fourteen days are free, and you do not need a bank card.

scenes.caption: Tap Start free
scenes.say: Tap the button that says Start free for fourteen days.

scenes.caption: Your name and business
scenes.say: Type your full name, then the name of your business, the way your customers know it.

scenes.caption: Email and password
scenes.sub: Each line turns green as you type.
scenes.say: Add your email address, then choose a strong password. Each line below the password turns green as you type.

scenes.caption: Create my account
scenes.say: Type the same password again, then tap Create my account.

scenes.caption: Check your email
scenes.sub: Nfelia sends you a welcome email.
scenes.say: You will get a welcome email from us. Open it, and tap the button to verify your email address.

scenes.caption: Email verified
scenes.say: Your email is now verified. Next, we tell Nfelia about your business.

scenes.caption: Country and what you sell
scenes.say: Choose your country, because it sets your money. Then choose what you sell. We sell hair, so we choose Products.

steps: Luxury hair. Delivered to your door.
scenes.caption: Hair & Beauty
scenes.sub: A short line your customers will see.
scenes.say: For the type of business, choose Hair and Beauty. Then add a short line about your business, for your customers to see.

steps: Shop 14, Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
scenes.caption: Phone, WhatsApp, address
scenes.sub: They go on your invoices and receipts.
scenes.say: Add your phone number, your WhatsApp number, and your shop address. They go on your invoices and your receipts.

scenes.caption: Save and continue
scenes.say: Tap Save and continue. Step two is about your money.

scenes.caption: Currency and tax
scenes.sub: No VAT? Leave the tax at 0.
scenes.say: Your currency comes from your country. If you do not charge VAT, leave the tax at zero.

scenes.caption: Where customers pay you
scenes.say: Now add the bank account your customers pay into. It shows on your invoices, so customers know where to pay.

scenes.caption: Your colours
scenes.sub: We use green and gold, from our logo.
scenes.say: Step three is how your business looks. Pick your main colour and your second colour. We use green and gold, from our logo.

scenes.caption: Lettering and logo
scenes.sub: Add your logo from your phone.
scenes.say: Choose the lettering you like, then tap the box to add your logo from your phone.

scenes.caption: One last step
scenes.say: Tap Save and continue. Now for the last step, your online shop.

scenes.caption: Your shop link
scenes.sub: The address you share on WhatsApp.
scenes.say: Choose your shop name. It becomes your shop link, the address you share on WhatsApp and Instagram.

scenes.caption: Pick a look
scenes.sub: Glow is made for hair and beauty.
scenes.say: Now pick a look for your shop. Glow is made for hair and beauty businesses, so it is already chosen for us.

scenes.caption: See it full size
scenes.say: Tap the button that says See it full size, to see the look before you choose it.

scenes.caption: Your shop is ready
scenes.say: Tap Save my shop. Your online shop is ready, and this is your Home.

scenes.caption: Days left in your trial
scenes.say: Here you can see how many days are left in your free trial.

scenes.caption: Your money this month
scenes.sub: What came in, what you spent, what is left.
scenes.say: This card shows the money that came in this month, what you spent, and what is left.

scenes.caption: Needs you
scenes.say: The Needs you card shows what to do today, like late payments, new orders, and stock that is running low.

scenes.caption: Home, Orders, Tasks, More
scenes.say: At the bottom of the screen, you have Home, Orders, Tasks and More.

scenes.caption: The + button
scenes.sub: Add a sale, order, quote, client or product.
scenes.say: The green plus button is how you add anything, like a new order, a quote, a client, or a product.

scenes.caption: More
scenes.say: More holds everything else, like your catalogue, your clients, your debts, and your shop studio.

scenes.caption: Settings
scenes.say: And in Settings, you can change your business details at any time.

card.title: Your products and your online shop
card.sub: Add your hair products, then share your shop on WhatsApp.

scenes.say: That is all for this video. Next time, we will add our hair products and open the online shop. See you there.
